title: Implementation Plan for Quantum AI Studio Cyberpunk Landing Page

steps.description: Create the complete standalone landing page for Quantum AI Studio. This includes the HTML5 structure, CSS with custom properties for neon glow and glassmorphism effects, and the JavaScript integration for tsparticles (background), and animation logic (counter-up and hover effects) as specified in ADR-8874.
steps.testCriteria: Verify that the page renders with a cyberpunk aesthetic, the particle background is interactive, and all hover/counter animations are smooth and responsive.

verificationGateChecklist: AST code health clean (no empty catch, no any)
